day6.title: The rhythm changes the day after tomorrow.
day6.body: You've spent a week among 4,325 quotes. In two days the pool gets smaller. I'll explain then — for now, keep reading.

day7.title: Today is the last day.
day7.body: There's a screen waiting for you tomorrow. It isn't a bad one.

ended.title: Seven days are up.
ended.changes:
From today you'll get at most 3 quotes a day.
And small ads will come between us. We're keeping them few enough not to bother you — I promise, they won't get in front of the moment you're reading.
ended.invite: For a week you walked among the words of Marcus Aurelius, Confucius, Seneca. Some arrived exactly when you needed them. You know which ones.
ended.inviteEmphasis: Don't give up the words that will change your life. This is your life — live it at its fullest.
ended.reassure:
But don't worry, we're not going anywhere.
Your favorites stay. Your history stays. Quotes will keep coming — just fewer, from a shallower pool.
The premium quotes you saved this week are not deleted; they stay locked and wait for you. You can come back any day.
